mentions.name: Scratch-built tool shed
mentions.description: A tool shed built completely from scratch using woodworking, as a hands-on DIY construction project producing a tangible physical result.
mentions.problem: The builder's day job is entirely virtual, so creating something tangible with woodworking offers a satisfying physical result.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a tool shed completely from scratch.   Actually doing woodwork (ok ok it was also an excuse to get a nice nail gun) and seeing something tangible at the end of your efforts is surprisingly nice if your day job is entirely virtual.
